Subject: noncommutative geometry | ID: 60367

Corollary

Step 3. By compactness of the compact spectral family \(B_{01320013}\), the image is precompact in the locally compact space topology.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via real interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
